Title: New Bloodlines discipline cards in forthcoming editions ?

Messages.Author: Orpheus
Messages.Body:
To the WW staff :

I'd like to know if there is an official position on that point.

In other words, do we have any chance, in future editions (the Anarchs,
maybe), to see, for example, split discipline cards including Myt, Obe and
the like ? New vampires of Bloodline CLans ?

Thanks,

--

I don't know that there are "less advantaged" bloodlines. The only one I

I would think that the Bali would fit nicely into the description of
underprivilaged. Aside from the occational trick deck and the guest
star appearence, these guys will very rarely see the light of day.

It is my opinion that there drawback is perhaps a little to severe.
Perhaps in future expansions they could make a few cards that would
lessen the blow of the infernal trait? Hopefully, they are super cool
vamps and really do deserve to get played.

It'll be interesting to see what they might do with them. Currently, you
really need to put a lot of effort into offsetting their cost and they
certainly do little more than guest star in a deck. It's tricky to build a
deck with them that other clans can do better. The Condemnations are really
the only thing I can see that they're particularly good for.
